name: AI Use Case Portfolio Ontology
description: A minimal, machine-readable ontology for governing an AI use case portfolio. The ontology drives validation, governance gates, and triage.

classes.label: AI Use Case
classes.description: A proposed or active application of AI to a business problem.

classes.label: Business Owner
classes.description: The accountable person for the use case outcome.

classes.label: Data Source
classes.description: An approved system or dataset the use case may read.

classes.label: Risk Tier
classes.description: A four-level risk classification from low to critical.

classes.label: Control
classes.description: A governance control such as human-in-the-loop or monitoring.

classes.label: Triage Bucket
classes.description: The portfolio decision: Now, Next, Later, or Hold.

risk_tiers.1: Low: internal productivity, low impact, reversible.
risk_tiers.2: Moderate: customer-facing or operational, limited impact.
risk_tiers.3: High: material financial, regulatory, or customer impact.
risk_tiers.4: Critical: safety, credit, or regulated decisioning with severe impact.
